translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Dwoko wach mamuol kweyo mirima,
to wach makwiny jimbo ich wangʼ.
Lew ngʼat mariek konyore gi rieko,
to dho ngʼat mofuwo hulo gik mofuwo.
Wenge Jehova Nyasaye ni kuonde duto,
karito joricho gi joma beyo.
Lep makelo ber en yath mar ngima,
to lep mar miriambo omiyo chuny bedo mool.
Ngʼat mofuwo chayo kum mar wuon mare,
to ngʼat mawinjo ka ikwere nyiso rieko.
Od ngʼat makare otingʼo mwandu maduongʼ,
to pok mar joricho kelo nigi chandruok.
Dho jomariek lando ngʼeyo,
to ngʼat mofuwo to wechene obam.
Jehova Nyasaye odagi misango mar jaricho,
to lamo mar ngʼat moriere tir miye mor.
Jehova Nyasaye odagi yore ngʼat marach,
to ohero jogo matimo gik makare.
Kum malit orito ngʼat maweyo yo,
ngʼat masin kikwere biro tho.
Jehova Nyasaye ongʼeyo gik moko matimore,
bed ni en Tho kata Kethruok,
omiyo dhano ok dipandne paro manie chunye!
Ngʼat ma jasunga dagi puonj,
ok odwar mondo ongʼadne rieko gi jomariek.
Chuny mamor miyo wangʼ bedo gi mor,
to chuny mokuyo miyo dhano bedo mool.
Chuny mongʼeyo pogo tiend weche dwaro ngʼeyo,
to dho ngʼat mofuwo chamo fuwo.
Ndalo duto mag ngʼat mahinyore gin thagruok,
to chuny mamor ni kod mor mosiko.
Ber bedo gi matin ka iluoro Jehova Nyasaye
moloyo mwandu mangʼeny kod koko.
Ber chamo alot kama hera nitie,
moloyo chamo ringʼo machwe kama achaya nitie.
Ngʼat ma iye wangʼ piyo medo miero,
to ngʼat ma terore mos kweyo dhawo.
Yor jasamuoyo olor gi kuthe,
to yor ngʼat moriere tir en yo malach.
Wuowi mariek miyo wuon mare mor,
to ngʼat mofuwo chayo min mare.
Fuwo moro ngʼat maonge gi rieko,
to ngʼat man-gi winjo wuotho moriere tir.
Chenro ok chopi nikech onge puonj makare,
to ka giyudo jongʼad rieko mangʼeny to gichopo.
Ngʼato yudo mor e dwoko mowinjore,
to mano ber manade kuom wach mochopo e sa midware.
Yor ngima telo kadhi malo ni ngʼat makare,
mondo ogengʼe kik odhi mwalo kar tho.
Jehova Nyasaye muko od ngʼat masungore,
to orito kiep dhako ma chwore otho ma ok omul.
Jehova Nyasaye odagi paro mar joricho,
to jogo ma chunygi ler miye mor.
Ngʼat ma jawuoro kelo chandruok ne joode,
to ngʼatno mamon gi asoya biro dak amingʼa.
Chuny ngʼat makare pimo dwokoge,
to dho ngʼat ma timbene richo hulo gik maricho.
Jehova Nyasaye bor gi ngʼat ma timbene richo,
to owinjo lamo mar ngʼat makare.
Neno mamor kelo mor ni chuny,
to wach maber miyo choke bedo gi ngima.
Ngʼat machiko ite kikwere
biro bedo thuolo e kind joma riek.
Ngʼat ma ok dew kum ochayore owuon,
to ngʼat mawinjo kikwere medo winjo wach.
Luoro Jehova Nyasaye puonjo dhano rieko,
to bedo mamuol kelo luor.
